name: Knott's Pacific Coast Paninis (Boardwalk) Toasted Turkey & Provolone or Ham & Swiss Panini (Plain Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Pacific Coast Paninis & Sandwiches (The Boardwalk · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Warm pressed artisan bread with sliced deli turkey and aged provolone or ham and Swiss—a much lighter, non-fried alternative to theme-park burgers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the Turkey or Ham Panini without raw tomatoes, red onions, or pesto spread, paired with plain potato chips.
